verdict.rationale: The evidence documents object-level linking, backlinks in the graph, and reuse of whole Objects and files without duplication. Nothing shows referencing or transcluding an individual block or section of one note inside another and keeping it in sync. A community user notes blocks are not objects and that converting them to objects is a lossy workaround, which is adjacent rather than the capability itself.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can reference or transclude an individual block or section of one note inside another and have it stay in sync
